subject: Level-number
notes: (kb/Work PB1246) A record description whose first entry is not level 1 is refused COBOL2771 at the binder's nesting walk (the empty-stack root arm); the report-group arm's refusal moved from the shared not-implemented code to COBOL2772. (kb/Work PB2516) A constant entry ends the record description before it (13.5.2 lists constant-entry beside record-description-entry; 13.11.1), so BindEntries closes the level stack there (CloseRecord) and a following 02-49 entry opens no record: COBOL2771. Before, `01 D. 05 A. 01 K CONSTANT AS 3. 05 B.` bound B into D's storage.
